title: Jesus Is Risen
summary: Jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read John 20:1-18 and look for how this passage teaches: Jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy.

tell_it: Mary found the tomb empty and met the risen Jesus. The resurrection changed fear into good news.
understand_it: Jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus Is Risen reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Resurrection matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus Is Risen shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy.
teen_explanation: Jesus Is Risen gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy.
God keeps His promises and gives His people future hope.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when resurrection is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did Mary find at the tomb?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: It was empty. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember John 20:18 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Jesus Is Risen?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Empty Tomb News
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Jesus Is Risen. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
